name: Elizabeth Margaret
source: The moth-er of the ship. Cook, maid, and probably other miscellaneous things, she seems to take it upon herself to keep the ship liveable. While generally a kind and patient person, she sometimes seems to get a bit irritated with the more lackadaisical members of the crew.
